resources.string: Swipe typing powered by FUTO Swipe
Gesture recognition uses the FUTO Swipe model by FUTO Holdings, Inc., under the FUTO Model Weights License.

The keyboard compares your swipe with many candidate words. A wider search finds the right word more often when a swipe is quick or sloppy, but takes a little more time and battery.

50: fastest, may miss words on quick sloppy swipes.
100: the previous default.
200: recommended. On our recordings the right word was among the top three suggestions 94.3 % of the time, against 92.5 % at 100, for about 0.3 ms more per swipe.
300 to 400: tiny gains, slightly slower on old phones.
